revenue_model.description: Omnicom sells marketing, sales, communications, and commerce services to large global companies through its global networks and specialized agencies.
revenue_model.quote: Omnicom Group Inc. is a strategic holding company that operates through global networks, connected capabilities and specialized agencies, which connect its comprehensive portfolio of companies to deliver marketing, sales, communications, and commerce services to many of the largest global companies.

business_structure.description: Omnicom Group Inc. is a publicly listed company on the NYSE, operating as a strategic holding company with four main global agency networks as its operating segments.
business_structure.quote: Omnicom’s common stock continues to trade on the New York Stock Exchange, or NYSE, under the symbol “OMC,”... Our global networks include: Omnicom Advertising (OA), Omnicom Media (OM), the DAS Group of Companies (DAS), and the Communications Consultancy Network (CCN).
